categories.main_business_segments: Beijing Beilu Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd. operates primarily in two segments: chemical pharmaceuticals and traditional Chinese medicine (TCM). The chemical pharmaceuticals segment focuses on contrast agents (MRI and CT contrast agents), anti-diabetic drugs, and raw materials. The TCM segment includes central nervous system drugs, heat-clearing and detoxifying medicines, and other categories such as cold remedies and digestive aids. The company also engages in R&D and production of raw materials and intermediates for its pharmaceutical products.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced pharmaceutical manufacturing technologies including production of iodine-based and gadolinium-based contrast agents with EU GMP and Brazil ANVISA GMP certifications. It employs integrated 'raw material + formulation' production methods, especially for contrast agents. The R&D process includes consistency evaluations for generic drugs and development of proprietary TCM formulations. The company also applies modern quality management systems and has a dedicated R&D subsidiary to enhance innovation efficiency.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include hospitals, medical institutions, and pharmaceutical distributors primarily within China. The company serves the medical imaging, diabetes treatment, and central nervous system therapeutic markets. Overseas markets include South America, Africa, and Asia (excluding the US). The TCM products target patients with anxiety, cardiovascular, respiratory, and digestive conditions. Major customers contribute about 18.7% of sales, indicating a diversified customer base.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China with significant sales in regions such as East China, North China, Central China, South China, Southwest, and Northwest China. It has expanded overseas sales to South America, Africa, and parts of Asia, with ongoing registration efforts in Hong Kong and Thailand. Production facilities are located in Beijing (headquarters and main plant), Cangzhou, Bozhou, and Taizhou, Zhejiang. The company is actively pursuing international certifications to support global market expansion.
categories.supply_chain_position: Beilu Pharma operates both upstream and midstream in the pharmaceutical supply chain. It produces raw materials (active pharmaceutical ingredients) for contrast agents and other drugs, as well as finished pharmaceutical formulations. The company integrates raw material production with formulation manufacturing, enabling control over the supply chain from raw materials to finished products. It also engages in R&D and marketing, positioning itself as a comprehensive pharmaceutical manufacturer.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic focus is on a dual-driven model of chemical pharmaceuticals and traditional Chinese medicine. R&D priorities include expanding contrast agent product lines, developing new anti-diabetic and CNS drugs, and innovating TCM products such as the proprietary anxiety treatment 'Jiuwei Zhenxin Granules'. It emphasizes efficiency improvements in resource allocation and project management. The company also pursues international registrations and certifications to accelerate global market penetration and invests in production capacity expansion.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through product sales of pharmaceutical formulations and raw materials. The company sells contrast agents, anti-diabetic drugs, TCM products, and raw materials directly to hospitals, distributors, and overseas clients. It also derives income from technology service fees related to pharmaceutical research and development. The company does not rely on subscription or licensing models but focuses on volume sales supported by national centralized procurement policies.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Beilu Pharma competes in the pharmaceutical manufacturing industry, particularly in contrast agents and TCM sectors. It holds a strong position in iodine and gadolinium contrast agents in China, with growing overseas presence. The company faces competition from other domestic and international pharmaceutical firms affected by national centralized procurement policies. Its acquisition of Tianyuan Pharmaceutical and expansion of TCM product lines aim to strengthen its market position and create a second growth curve.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenues of approximately RMB 983.55 million, a 10.42% increase year-over-year. Net profit attributable to shareholders was RMB 13.65 million, reversing previous losses with a 119.02% increase. The company’s total assets reached RMB 2.98 billion, growing 5.61%. Cash flow from operations improved significantly by 178.85%. The company has shown recovery and growth after overcoming pricing pressures from centralized procurement, supported by strategic acquisitions and R&D investments.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Beilu Pharma emphasizes its dual-driven business model combining chemical pharmaceuticals and traditional Chinese medicine to provide diversified therapeutic solutions. Its contrast agents cover a broad spectrum of iodine and gadolinium products with international certifications, ensuring quality and compliance for domestic and overseas markets. The company’s proprietary TCM products, such as the nationally recognized 'Jiuwei Zhenxin Granules' for anxiety, offer unique clinical benefits with low side effects. Integration of raw material production with formulation manufacturing enhances supply stability and cost control, differentiating it from competitors.
